dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000qu91](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000qu91) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 0.0 depth occurred on Sep 05 2025 34km NW of Ayangue. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -1.8831 longitude -81.0479. It impacted 346460 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
